matt-release: Quick sync: target deploy 21:10 UTC — api@v1.12.0 runtime@2.15.1 router@3.7.0. Console needs X-Canary header for routing.
sana-runtime: Runtime change is an opt-in batching toggle + prefetch tweak. Batching OFF for canary.
lee-router: Router accepts X-Canary and will prefer sticky flows when present; safe fallback if missing.
katie-console: Ill add header in proxy for canary tokens, PR coming to hotfix branch.
rachel-eng: Suggest pins for first two waves. Rollback rule: if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR regen p95 > +20% for 5m -> rollback runtime only. Also auto-hold on mem > 82%.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by matt-release at 21:10 UTC. Waves: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Pin command queued.
matt-release: Pin before first wave: /deploy pin api@v1.12.0 runtime@2.15.1 router@3.7.0 --note "canary pin 21:10"
deploy-bot: Pin received. Confirm with thumbs.
sana-runtime: :thumbsup:
lee-router: :thumbsup:
katie-console: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Wave 1 (10%) started at 21:10:08 UTC. Monitors enabled: latency, 5xx, sticky misses, mem.
sana-runtime: Wave1 looks fine. Batching OFF, prefetch cold misses expected.
lee-router: Headers present. No sticky issues.
deploy-bot: Wave 2 (50%) started at 21:18:40 UTC.
sana-runtime: At 50% regen p95 +12% vs baseline, 5xx 0.09%. No mem pressure.
rachel-eng: Good. Proceed to 100% after 5m hold.
deploy-bot: Wave 3 (100%) started at 21:24:20 UTC.
sana-runtime: After 100% p95 settled at +10%. No sustained 5xx.
matt-release: Unpin api/router now, keep runtime pinned +15m for observation. /deploy unpin api router
deploy-bot: Commands executed. Runtime pinned until 21:39:20 UTC.
katie-console: Posting release note with header and batching info.
matt-release: Thanks all. Closing thread. :tada:
